definitions.angle: 2-D angle (deg) between the body line (mid-ankle -> mid-shoulder) and the ski axis. Positive = body above the skis. null when the view is frontal/rear (angle not observable) or skis not found.
definitions.angle_leg: same, but body line = mid-ankle -> mid-hip
definitions.angle_torso: same, but body line = mid-hip -> mid-shoulder
definitions.angle_raw: angle before outlier rejection (always reported, even for frontal views - use with care)
definitions.outlier: true if angle_raw deviated > 15 deg from the median of its neighbours (+-0.3 s, same shot) or had < 2 such neighbours; angle is then null
definitions.angle_smooth: median of 3 neighbouring samples in the same shot
definitions.body_inclination: body line vs image horizontal (deg, camera-dependent)
definitions.ski_inclination: ski axis vs image horizontal (deg, camera-dependent)
definitions.view: side | oblique | frontal (estimated from body width / ski V)
definitions.confidence: 0..1 heuristic (pose visibility x ski support x view)
definitions.segment: index of continuous airborne segment (a broadcast may show the same jump several times: live + replays)
